question: The marks obtained by 11 students in a class are 25, 6, 15, 8, 22, 16, 9, 21, 18, 13, and 20. Find the median.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total numbers (n) = 11, which is odd.

The median is the (11 + 1) ÷ 2 = 6th term in ascending order.

The 5 smallest numbers are 6, 8, 9, 13, and 15.

The next smallest (6th) number is 16.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks: 25, 6, 15, 8, 22, 16, 9, 21, 18, 13, 20

Total number of students (n) = 11

**Formula Used:**

If n is odd, Median = value of the ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th observation when arranged in ascending order.

 Data in Ascending Order

 
 6
